BiblicalUsage: Battah means desolation, a waste place, and Isaiah says the flies and bees will come and rest in the desolate valleys and the holes of the rocks when Assyria comes.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that desolation is the land God gives over to judgment, and the valleys that once sang will lie empty until He restores them.
